design: INDIVIDUAL 19: a very broad elderly councillor with muscular forearms and green-brown scales, broad rear skull with small irregular facial quills, short charcoal tendrils with wide silver cuffs. A knee-length burgundy coat with one large layered ivory shoulder drape, plain long skirt, heavy bronze angular belt and a necklace of three long ancestral plaques. Carries an octagonal council reliquary low in both hands. Sturdy open stance and exposed strong clawed feet.
